message.content:
Deploy the completed admin-board expansion (and a small email UI fix) from the /opt/nxeon working tree through the project's own pipeline: commit → staging → production, with staging as a hard health gate. This is a git repo whose `.git/hooks/post-commit` auto-pushes to `origin main`.

CONTEXT: An admin-board feature expansion was just built and is UNCOMMITTED in the working tree. It type-checks clean (`npx tsc` passes for app code; `next build` compiled successfully). The DB schema change (new `App` model + `Board.appId`) was ALREADY applied to the production `nxeon` DB via `prisma db push`, and apps were seeded — so the DB is already ahead of the code; deploying the code is safe.

FILES TO COMMIT (these are the intended changes — add exactly these, do not `git add -A` blindly in case stray scratch files exist):
- prisma/schema.prisma
- prisma/seed.ts
- lib/actions-board.ts
- lib/board-shared.ts
- app/admin/board/page.tsx
- components/admin/BoardClient.tsx
- components/portal/Shell.tsx
- components/customer/EmailHosting.tsx
- docs/DOCUMENTATION.md

STEPS (run from /opt/nxeon; capture and report output of each):
1. `git status --short` — report it. If any of the FILES TO COMMIT are missing from the changes, note it.
2. `git add` the exact files listed above (skip any that don't show as modified/new). Then `git diff --cached --stat` — report what's staged. Ensure NO stray `scripts/_*.ts` scratch files or secrets are staged; if any are, unstage them.
3. Commit:
   `git commit -m "$(printf 'Boards: app binding + UX overhaul + stage-action pipeline; drop dead webmail link\n\nEpic A: App model + Board.appId, per-app board switcher.\nEpic B: full-text card search, better DnD, drag-to-delete, filters/labels, full-width layout, keyboard shortcuts.\nEpic C: confirm-gated stage actions (docs/staging/prod/github).\nRemove scrapped mail.nxeon.cloud webmail links from Business Email UI.\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>')"`
   The post-commit hook auto-pushes to origin main — confirm the push happened (check `/var/log/nxeon-git-push.log` tail and/or `git log origin/main -1 --oneline`).
4. Deploy to STAGING: run `bash scripts/deploy-staging.sh` (it does git reset --hard origin/main in /opt/nxeon-staging, npm install, prisma db push, seed, npm run build, restarts nxeon-staging-web/worker, health-checks port 8080). Capture full output.
5. GATE: if deploy-staging FAILED (non-zero exit, build error, or health check not 200 on 8080), STOP — do NOT promote to production. Report the failure with the relevant log lines.
6. If staging is healthy, sanity-check the board route responds on staging (e.g. `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/board` — a 200/307/302 is fine, a 500 is a problem; report the code).
7. If staging healthy: promote to PRODUCTION with `bash scripts/promote-production.sh` (it re-verifies staging healthy, rebuilds /opt/nxeon, restarts nxeon-web/worker, health-checks port 80). Capture output.
8. Verify production health: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1/` (expect 200/3xx) and that `nxeon-web` is active (`systemctl is-active nxeon-web`). Report.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT modify any board/app source logic — you are only committing + deploying what's there.
- Do NOT touch the Soul Pilates `.200` box, DNS, or any mail config.
- If `deploy-staging.sh` fails on `npm install`/build for reasons unrelated to the board code (pre-existing), report exactly what and stop before prod.
- If a safety classifier blocks a command, report it verbatim and stop.

Return a structured report: git status summary, commit hash + push confirmation, staging deploy result (build + health + board route code), the go/no-go gate decision, production promote result + health, and anything that failed.
